metadata.description: Phase 09.1 style for the flutter_map + vector_map_tiles engine. Frozen 6-layer order (background / landcover / water / boundaries / roads / pois) derived from the Protomaps basemaps neutral light variant. Compiled once per MapTheme by lib/infrastructure/map/map_theme_loader.dart (vector_tile_renderer ThemeReader); the root `id` keys the vector_map_tiles memory + file caches, so every theme MUST carry a distinct id. Text is rendered by vector_tile_renderer's TextPainter with the platform font: no glyphs, no sprite. Downstream plans may tune paint properties but MUST NOT reorder the layers — the order is asserted by kStyleLayerOrder (lib/infrastructure/map/style_layer_order.dart) and test/presentation/map_style_layer_order_test.dart.
metadata.mirkfall:fog_note: The fog of war is NOT a style layer any more. It is painted by the FogLayer widget, a child of the same FlutterMap as the VectorTileLayer (Phase 09.1 same-canvas port-back, BUG-014). The Phase 07 `mirk_fog` transparent background layer was removed because vector_tile_renderer ignores background-opacity and would paint the whole map black (Phase 09.1 C7).
